summary: Verify containerized metrics-utility with `systemctl --user list-timers --no-pager | grep metrics-utility` (gather and build-report timers) and `systemctl --user status metrics-utility-gather.service`.
questions: How do I check the metrics-utility systemd timer?
How do I verify metrics-utility data collection on containerized AAP?

answer_card.title: Verify metrics-utility timers
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
systemctl --user list-timers --no-pager | grep metrics-utility
# expect metrics-utility-gather.timer and metrics-utility-build-report.timer
systemctl --user status metrics-utility-gather.service
```
